ieee.name: IEEE Transactions & Conference Format
ieee.abstract_style: italicized block without heading or with IEEEtran standard heading
ieee.primary_font: Times New Roman / Computer Modern Roman

acm.name: ACM Conference / Journal (SIGCONF)
acm.abstract_style: standard ACM block with CCS Concepts and Keywords

springer_lncs.name: Springer Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNCS)
springer_lncs.abstract_style: standard LNCS single-column abstract followed by keywords

elsevier.name: Elsevier Article (elsarticle)
elsevier.abstract_style: frontmatter abstract block with highlights and keywords

nature_science.name: Nature / Science Interdisciplinary Format
nature_science.section_numbering: Minimal / Bold inline headers without formal numbers
nature_science.abstract_style: unreferenced ~150-200 word summary paragraph presenting background, gap, result, and broader meaning

neurips.name: NeurIPS / ICML / ICLR Machine Learning Format
neurips.abstract_style: bold abstract header with indented block

generic_apa.name: Generic Academic / APA 7th Edition Format
generic_apa.abstract_style: standard centered Abstract title with single block text
